verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented capability to export all account data in open formats. The "migration support included" claim concerns switching to AiPrise, not leaving it, and general verification APIs are only developer building blocks, not a data-export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
